notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Battle Hymn and Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.
